decisions.reason: As a close extension of the existing catalog that remained prominently listed across its first two observed years, it likely performed near aspiration and is worth retaining in a growing niche market.
This series builds directly on the firm’s curatorial strengths and label capabilities, so with no clear sign of failure a mature firm with some catalog slack would tend to keep it.
A reissued jazz vinyl LP fits the firm’s reissue competence and genre-broadening path, making continued retention more likely unless results clearly fall short of aspiration.
A multi-disc box set is close to the core offer but ties up more resources and inventory risk, so if its niche sales are only borderline the firm is more likely to reallocate those resources.
Because it received weaker website support than the others and is a less distinctive close-to-core CD product, management would be more likely to view it as underperforming and remove it.
